Pet
 Versus
 1. The State of Bihar
 2. Shaheen Praveen @ Shaheen Parveen Wife Of Md.
 Husaini Resdient Of Village- Sitanabad, Ps-
 Bakhtiyarpur, Distt- Saharsa
 ... ...

Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Pramod Mishra  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Dr. Indiwar Kumari  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ANJANI KUMAR SHARAN  ORAL ORDER 5 15-05-2024 Heard learned counsel for the parties.
2. The petitioner apprehends his arrest in a case registered for the offences punishable under Sections 147, 149, 323, 380, 354, 498A, 307 and 306 of the Indian Penal Code. .
3. Petitioner, who is husband of opposite party no2., is said to have ousted the opposite party no.2 from her matrimonial home in association of his family members over the dowry demand.
4. Vide order dated 31.01.2024, the matter was referred to the Mediation and Conciliation Center of the Patna High Court to amicably resolve the dispute between the parties.

entities.text: Mediation and Conciliation Center of the Patna High Court
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
The learned Mediator has submitted its report dated 08.05.2024 Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.63141 of 2023(5)
dt.15-05-2024 in which it is clearly stated that the dispute between the parties has been resolved and the terms of settlement mutually agreed upon by them is being attached with this report.

5. In that view of the matter, let the above named petitioner, be released on bail, in the event of his arrest or surrender before the learned Court below within a period of six weeks from today, on Md. Husaini vs The State Of Bihar on 15 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/106053621/
1 furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Court below where the case is pending/successor Court in connection with Complaint Case No.1366C/2019, subject to the condition as laid down under Section 438 (2) of the Cr.P.C.
(Anjani Kumar Sharan, J) Trivedi/-
U T Md. Husaini vs The State Of Bihar on 15 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/106053621/
